content: Yagaiꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌmogimo, Yesuꞌmo atafauta kalavusi huta ateteta amagigune, huꞌa huꞌnaya gemae
Yesuꞌa muki geꞌamo alagi hapa paino hano hutenoꞌaeꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo hapa painoꞌaeꞌmo,

ago afiꞌnayana lole afinaꞌmo utesigeno Pasova hopa afinaꞌmo afole aigiye. Afole aitesigeꞌapaeꞌmo Vemo mafaꞌnemo malipu yosaleꞌmo nili aiteꞌa aliꞌa he tiꞌa atesayafeꞌmo avaleli uꞌa apamigae, huno hapa paiꞌniye.

Inagi mono huꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaiꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌe Yu vayatama vayaꞌmogiꞌeꞌmo hogote vekamo mono huꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaino neꞌapateya vekamo agiꞌamo Kaiyafasi alopa noꞌafiꞌmo aliꞌa anupa huꞌa maiꞌnae.
Apakaemo kesi katetiꞌmo uꞌa Yesuꞌmo atafauꞌa kalavusi huꞌa ateteꞌa amagisayafeꞌmo ge huge afige huꞌa maiꞌnae.
Apakaemo, fiku yanageꞌa apano aegae, huꞌa apakesa afiteꞌa, hopa afinaꞌmo oꞌatafaugune, huꞌa huꞌnae.
Mago a kanoꞌmoꞌmo uvelimo lakino Yesuꞌmo faleno ateꞌniya gemae
Yesuꞌa Metani taonifiꞌmo mago vekamo Saimoniꞌa lepalosi yaꞌmo hauꞌniya vekamo nopiꞌmo haino maiꞌniye.
Fai maiꞌneꞌa neꞌyaꞌmo neꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo mago a kanomoꞌa yafa kepi uvelimo alagepa atumo neꞌaiya uvelimo lusi moniletiꞌmo miya nefaiya uvelimo alinineno agenopafiꞌmo lakino faleno ateꞌniye.
Geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌmogimo ani kavaꞌmo ageteꞌapaeꞌmo apaipamo leꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo, na kava higeno fiku lakino faleno ateꞌniye.
Maketi huꞌniyesinana lusi monimo aliteno kagemi yaꞌapimo ohaneꞌnisiya vayaꞌmo apamiꞌniyesine, huꞌa ge hauꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa ani gemo afitenoꞌaeꞌmo, na kava higetapa lusi kana yaꞌmo alitapa neꞌamiye. Nagaetegamo kanale alagepa kavaꞌmo huꞌniye.
Muki afinaꞌmo kagemi yaꞌapimo ohaneꞌniya vayaꞌmo ma mopafiꞌmo lapakaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeꞌa maigayaꞌmonanafa nagaemo muki afinaꞌmo lapakaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeꞌna oꞌmaiguve.
Nagufamo alo huno nateꞌniyanageꞌa kanolufiꞌmo kiꞌa natesaya afinafeꞌmo alagepa atumo neꞌaiya uveliletiꞌmo faleno nateꞌniye.
Lama ge lapa nepauve, huno, mani alagepa faigoko gemo aeꞌa hakalo huꞌa hapa paisaya kotegamo mani aꞌmoꞌa huꞌniya kavaꞌefeꞌmo apakesa afisayafeꞌmo ava gemo hugae, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Yutasiꞌa Yesu kutulu yaꞌmo aliguve, huno huꞌniya gemae
Yutasiꞌa Isakaliyoti kotega vekamo tuolofuꞌa vayapati vekamo apataleno mono huꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaiꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌaitegamo uno hapa painoꞌaeꞌmo,
avaleꞌna lapamisuvafeꞌmo na agufa yaꞌmo namigae, huno apafi geꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo tetiꞌa siluva monimo lekana paiꞌa amiꞌnae.
Ani afinatetiꞌmo Yutasiꞌa aepa faino atafausiya afinafeꞌmo yagaino maiꞌniye.
Pasova neꞌyaꞌmo neꞌnaya kavafeꞌmo huꞌniya gemae

Yu vayaꞌmogi aeno apafu noleya peleti mayamo neꞌnaya hopa afinapatiꞌmo hogote afinaꞌmo afole aiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌmo Yesutegamo eꞌa, Pasova neꞌyaꞌmo nesunafeꞌmo haiyategamo uta alo hisune, huꞌa ge huꞌa afi geꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo,

Neꞌyaꞌmo neꞌneꞌapaeꞌmo, lama ge lapa nepauve, huno, mani lapakaepatiꞌmo mago vekamoꞌa nagae kutulu yaꞌmo ago aliꞌniyanageno kame vayaꞌmo navaleno apamigiye, huno hapa paiꞌniye.

Vemo mafaꞌnemoꞌa Goti mukufiꞌmo ago avoꞌmo kae maleꞌnaya kateꞌmo ugiyaꞌmonanafa kutulu yaꞌmo aliꞌniya vekalegamo lusi aiye aiye avovo kavaꞌmo afole aigiye. Itaꞌamoꞌmo alino oꞌateꞌniyesinana agaetefeꞌmo kanale hiyesine, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Yutasiꞌmo kutulu yaꞌmo aliꞌniya vekamoꞌa hunoꞌaeꞌmo, Tisao, huno, nagaefeꞌmo nehapiye, huno afi geꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo Yesuꞌa, ago alagi nehane, huno ha paiꞌniye.
